topics.purpose: Define exact parent/child recursion for composite Projects with cycle prevention and deterministic closure.

semantics.parent_rule: Each child relation references exact parent and child Project identities.
semantics.leaf_rule: Project is leaf iff it has no active/accepted child containment edges under the declared profile.
semantics.order_rule: Sibling order is explicit presentation/planning metadata where used.
semantics.authority_rule: Parent Project does not automatically grant AccessCore rights to child.

invariants.rule: Composition never silently transfers semantic ownership: universal modules own their primitives, domains own their composition semantics, and composed members retain their own identities and contracts.

Containment, relation, dependency, composition and projection edges exist only through explicit typed references; naming, file hierarchy, UI adjacency or shared values never create semantic structure.
